a hybrid lexicon consisting of word and PMs can be used to resolve the problem OOV words in LVCSR.
a hybrid lexicon based on word and sub word unit can be used to reduce the OOV problem of an open vocabulary system.

the proposed hybrid lexicon of PMs and words is a resource efficient way to handle OOV words and the proposed hybrid RNLLM framework can effectively model the hybrid input and achieve both high recognition accuracy and computational efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of hybrid lexicon and a hybrid input type RNNLM for resource efficient LVCSR.
the development of a resource efficient hybrid language model for Thai LVCSR and speech to speech tasks.
the development of a hybrid language model based on a combination of words and pseudo morphemes for the Thai language.

the proposed hybrid RNLLM is a resource efficient language model that can achieve high accuracy and low computational cost for LVCSR.
this thesis presents a hybrid input type recurrent network language model for open vocabulary speech recognition that can be used as an alternative to the n-gram language model.
this work has successfully demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid input type RNNLM in terms of resource efficiency, recognition accuracy, and computational time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully developed an efficient language model for LVCSR by combining the benefits from different input units and a hybrid input vector.

the hybrid lexicon is a promising approach for building an open vocabulary language model for LVCSR as it is both resource efficient and can provide a good trade off between recognition accuracy and computational cost.
the proposed hybrid LM is both resource efficient and computationally fast while still being able to achieve the best recognition accuracy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a hybrid lexicon can be a good alternative for an open vocabulary language model.
the hybrid input type RNNLM framework can effectively model the long context dependency and the hybrid lexicon is an open vocabulary for LVCSR.
a hybrid lexicon can be used to resolve the problem on OOV words in resource efficient way and a hybrid input type RNNLM is a good candidate for LVCSR language models.
